record.one_liner: Linear is a project and issue tracking tool for software teams, with issues, projects, cycles and roadmaps.
record.auth_notes: Personal API keys are created in Security & access settings and sent as `Authorization: <API_KEY>` with no Bearer prefix. OAuth2 authorization-code flow (optional PKCE, actor=user or app) gives 24h access tokens with refresh tokens. OAuth2 client_credentials is also available for server-to-server use (app actor, 30-day token) once enabled on the app. OAuth access tokens are sent as Bearer.
record.access_notes: Personal API keys and OAuth2 apps are created self-serve in workspace settings. The fetched OAuth page lists no app review or approval step. I did not fetch a page on plan requirements, so whether the free plan gets full API access is not verified. The OAuth page recommends a dedicated workspace for app development.
record.blocker: none. Rate limits not reviewed; free-plan API access not explicitly verified.
